actus.title: Basile Bourgnon, wins the Route du Rhum - Destination Guadeloupe in the Ocean Fifty class*
actus.excerpt: Young French skipper Basile Bourgnon held firm to the very end,  winning the Ocean Fifty class on the Route du Rhum Destination Guadeloupe in the very early hours of this morning. His is a win full of flair and symbolic significance. Basile Bourgnon emerged triumphant following an incredible battle in the Ocean Fiftys.

actus.title: Bourgnon, like father like son
actus.excerpt: Nearly thirty years after his late father Laurent’s two back to back victories in the Route du Rhum – Destination Guadeloupe (1994 and 1998), young Basile Bourgnon has turned this edition of the iconic race into a family legacy. actus.excerpt: Le skipper de Liamm a franchi la ligne ce lundi, à 12 h 31 (heure locale), 17 h 31 (heure de Paris). Alors qu’il disputait sa première transatlantique en Ultim, Guirec Soudée a réalisé une performance remarquable. actus.title: IMOCa: loco coco set to hit the buffers, goodchild slowed
actus.excerpt: On the second Monday morning of the 13th edition of the Route du Rhum Destination Guadeloupe, the fight in the IMOCA class has shaped up to be very much for second and third step on the podium. Leader Corentin Horeau is closer to the finish than his nearest pursuer Boris Herrmann (Malizia 4) behind is.

actus.title: Podium set but Ocean fifty and Class40 leads are open
actus.excerpt:
A 320-mile lead with 380 miles to go: Corentin Horeau (IMOCA) holds a substantial cushion but knows nothing is decided until the finish line.

actus.title: Louis Burton :  I only eased off the throttle twice
actus.excerpt: Louis Burton was a happy man when he got to the pontoon in Pointe-à-Pitre. He danced exubebrantly on the trampoline of his giant Ultim having just taken third on his first Route du Rhum – Destination Guadeloupe in the Ultim class after just a few months of sailing aboard Ultim Armand Thiery.
